description: This file defines data structures, enums, function prototypes, and constants for managing archive files within an archiving utility, including archive types, statuses, entries, and operations.

classes.name: XArchive
classes.description: Main structure representing an archive, including its properties, capabilities, and associated UI components.

classes.name: XEntry
classes.description: Represents a file or directory entry within an archive.

classes.name: XAClipboard
classes.description: Structure for clipboard operations related to archive entries.

classes.name: compressor_t
classes.description: Structure defining compression levels and options.

classes.name: ArchiveType
classes.description: Associates an archive type with a tag.

classes.name: XArchiver
classes.description: Structure defining an archiver program and its associated functions.

methods.name: xa_build_full_path_name_from_entry
methods.description: Constructs full path name from an archive entry.

methods.name: xa_clean_archive_structure
methods.description: Cleans and frees archive structure.

methods.name: xa_create_containing_directory
methods.description: Creates directory containing a given path.

methods.name: xa_create_working_directory
methods.description: Creates a working directory for archive operations.

methods.name: xa_create_working_subdirectory
methods.description: Creates a subdirectory within the working directory.

methods.name: xa_detect_encrypted_archive
methods.description: Detects if an archive is encrypted.

methods.name: xa_fill_dir_sidebar
methods.description: Fills directory sidebar UI component.

methods.name: xa_fill_list_with_recursed_entries
methods.description: Recursively fills list with archive entries.

methods.name: xa_find_archive_index
methods.description: Finds index of an archive.

methods.name: xa_find_entry_from_dirpath
methods.description: Finds an archive entry from directory path.

methods.name: xa_free_entry
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an archive entry.

methods.name: xa_get_compressed_tar_type
methods.description: Checks if archive type is a compressed tar type.

methods.name: xa_get_new_archive_index
methods.description: Returns a new index for an archive.

methods.name: xa_has_containing_directory
methods.description: Checks if archive has a containing directory.

methods.name: xa_init_archive_structure
methods.description: Initializes archive structure based on type.

methods.name: xa_run_command
methods.description: Executes a command related to archive operations.

methods.name: xa_set_archive_entries_for_each_row
methods.description: Sets archive entries for display rows.

methods.name: xa_dir_sidebar_row_selected
methods.description: Handles directory sidebar row selection.

methods.name: xa_dir_sidebar_select_row
methods.description: Selects a specific row in directory sidebar.

methods.name: xa_sort_dirs_before_files
methods.description: Sorts entries with directories before files.

methods.name: xa_spawn_async_process
methods.description: Spawns an asynchronous process for archive operations.
